# RivalFrame

RivalFrame provides done-for-you competitive and market intelligence for B2B SaaS and AI teams.

## Core service
RivalFrame takes one real business question, investigates public evidence around competitors, pricing, positioning, buyer pain, product and market changes, and returns a concise source-linked brief with confidence labels and recommended next actions.

## Launch offer
24-Hour Competitor Intelligence Brief — €79 launch pilot.

## Method
Signal → Evidence → Implication → Decision.

## Important trust policy
RivalFrame distinguishes verified facts, inference and uncertainty. Material claims remain attached to sources. If the public record cannot support a useful answer, RivalFrame says so before paid work begins.
